Everything looks correct and complete.

## Summary

Added many-to-many category support to items, following the existing Item resource patterns exactly:

- **`app/models.py`**: `Category`/`CategoryBase`/`CategoryCreate`/`CategoryPublic`/`CategoriesPublic` (mirroring the Item* family) plus an `ItemCategoryLink` join table. `Item` gained a `categories` relationship, `ItemCreate` gained `category_ids: list[uuid.UUID]`, and `ItemPublic` now returns nested `categories`.
- **`app/crud.py`**: `create_category`, and `create_item` now attaches categories by ID (used by test helpers).
- **`app/api/routes/categories.py`** (new): `POST/GET/DELETE /categories/`, styled like `items.py`. Since categories are a shared/global resource with no owner, create and delete are superuser-gated (matching the precedent in `users.py`), list requires only authentication.
- **`app/api/routes/items.py`**: `create_item` now resolves `category_ids` and 404s if any don't exist.
- **`app/api/main.py`**: registered the categories router.
- **Migration**: `162c76b9ab5c_add_categories_and_item_category_link.py`, generated via `alembic revision --autogenerate` and applied.
- **Tests**: `tests/utils/category.py` helper + `tests/api/routes/test_categories.py` covering create/list/delete (including permission and not-found cases) and item creation with/without/invalid category IDs. `tests/conftest.py` teardown now also clears the `Category` table.

One environment note: the local Postgres instance had leftover `category`/`itemcategorylink` tables and an alembic version from some unrelated prior run that didn't match any migration in this repo — I reset it to the repo's actual migration head before building the real migration, so it wasn't reused as a shortcut.

`uv run bash scripts/lint.sh` passes, and all 70 backend tests pass (60 pre-existing + 10 new), with the existing `test_items.py` untouched.
